thread:
Olivia: Heads up — NVIDIA + a Big SI asked if we can combine a private offer on AWS Marketplace that layers: Redwood committed spend discounts + NVIDIA promo credits. They want clear SKU minimums, stackable credits, and a coordinated joint announcement once the first 3 customers onboard. Can we do that? cc @Ravi :thinking:

Ravi: Love it. Key customer ask: credits stack on top of our committed discount so net price is meaningful to them. They also want a 12–24 month renewal cadence and predictable uplift on renewals.

Jess: We need to be careful — AWS Marketplace has rules about pass-through credits and how private offers are represented. Also need to confirm whether OEM credits can be applied on top of a Marketplace private offer or if they must be off-invoice. I'll dig AWS docs and ask our AWS partner rep.

Tom: High level finance POV: we can support stacking but need defined floor margin. Proposal: require minimum committed ARR per region (suggest US-EAST minimum $250k commit) and tiered discounts. If NVIDIA credits are applied, they should be capped to avoid reducing our net below floor.

Mei: Implementation notes: we'll need explicit SKU mapping for Dedicated vs Hosted, clear entitlement logic, and onboarding steps for SI. Sample SKU names: REDW-HOST-STD, REDW-DED-1, REDW-SI-INTEGRATION. Also need a quick playbook for SI to claim credits during procurement.

Marketplace-bot: Helpful link: https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/management/tco/private-offers/ (also flagged limitations on combined promotions).

Olivia: Putting some concrete numbers on the table so we can iterate:

```
Commit Tier A: $250,000 annual -> 12% off list
Commit Tier B: $500,000 annual -> 20% off list
Commit Tier C: $1,000,000+ -> 28% off list
NVIDIA Promo: up to $200k applied per year, allowed on top of our discount but capped so net >= 8% margin
Renewal: auto-renew 12 months, customer can opt-out with 60 days notice; renewal discount step-downs limited to -2% year-over-year
```

Olivia: Also think about reporting/audits — SI or NVIDIA credits should be auditable. AWS may insist on how credits are documented.

Jess: +1 on auditability. Need contract language: "Credits cannot be used to inflate usage reports" and "Credits are applied post-invoice as a bill credit" — confirm with AWS if private offers can carry that. If not, we need an off-marketplace rebate agreement.

Ravi: On the GTM side, SI wants a co-selling package: joint datasheet + two customer references before public announcement. They want a soft launch with 3 pilot customers, then announce. Suggest timeline: pilot sign by Q3, public PR in Q4.

Mei: Ops checklist for pilots: 1) map SKUs in Marketplace 2) enable dedicated pool provisioning for SI customers 3) onboarding runbook and runbook test with SI 4) telemetry hooks for usage & credits reporting.

Tom: Financial guardrails we should lock in before we commit: minimum commit by region, minimum term = 12 months, credit cap per contract, and true-up clause at 6 months. I'll model P&L with these knobs.

Olivia: Sounds like action items. I'll draft a straw LOI and an initial private offer structure for AWS.

Jess: I'll review LOI and advise on language re: credits, audit, and termination.

Ravi: I'll own the SI coord and PR timeline. I'll pull in the SI account lead to confirm references.

Mei: I'll build the SKU mapping and a short onboarding playbook (1 pager).

Marketplace-bot: Note added to partnerships board: private-offer + OEM-credit request. Jira ticket suggested: PART-6421.

Olivia: Meeting to sync on Monday 9am PT? If yes, I'll invite Tom/Jess/Ravi/Mei and the AWS rep. :calendar:
